As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Senior Integrated Designer - 12 month FTC

Location:  London, United Kingdom  

About the role: 

As Senior Integrated Designer, you'll lead creative thinking and execution across the studio's full channel mix, from initial concept through to final delivery across digital, social, motion, print, and events. You'll bring both ideas and craft to every brief, ensuring work is visually strong, strategically considered, and consistent across touchpoints and markets. 

Operating within a regulated financial services environment, you'll bring discipline to compliance-sensitive materials, set quality benchmarks for the team, embed AI-assisted design workflows, and help build a studio the wider organisation is proud of. 

What you will be doing: 

 Integrated Design & Creative Production 

  • Concept and create on-brand integrated work across the full channel mix, brand campaigns, digital and social content, motion, print, events, marketing collateral, thought leadership, and long-form communications, from brief through to final delivery 
  • Bring integrated thinking to every brief, considering how ideas translate across channels, formats, and markets before execution begins 
  • Produce motion and animation work for digital and social, applying strong storytelling and timing principles alongside visual craft 
  • Adapt integrated design solutions for seven markets and multiple product lines, maintaining visual and conceptual consistency within brand guardrails; prepare all files to correct digital, motion, and print specifications 
  • Manage multiple live projects simultaneously, maintaining brand integrity, quality standards, and deadlines across all output 

 Brand Guardianship & Consistency 

  • Champion consistency of visual identity, tone, and quality across every touchpoint and market, proactively identifying opportunities to strengthen brand expression 
  • Apply compliance requirements, disclaimers, substantiation standards, and sign-off checkpoints, as standard practice, with approvals documented correctly 
  • Contribute to brand guidelines, scalable templates, and asset systems that enable speed and consistency across the studio 

 Team Leadership & Collaboration 

  • Lead, direct, and mentor the design team, providing clear creative briefs, constructive feedback, and development support that raises capability and output quality across the integrated mix 
  • Work closely with the embedded team and client stakeholders to develop integrated creative ideas, translating feedback into clear direction for the team 

 Gen AI & Agentic Thinking 

  • Apply advanced AI tools to enhance integrated creative output and workflows, building effective prompts, critically evaluating results, and maintaining rigorous human oversight of quality and compliance 
  • Design and embed AI-assisted workflows for the team, setting quality benchmarks and guiding responsible AI use across sizing, adaptation, motion, transcreation, and production efficiency 
  • Break down complex, multi-format creative challenges into clear steps, leading the team to the best outcome efficiently and adapting confidently when priorities shift 

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • A strong portfolio demonstrating integrated creative thinking and execution across digital, social, motion, print, and campaign formats, with evidence of both conceptual originality and hands-on craft 
  • Advanced proficiency across Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop, After Effects) and Figma; expert understanding of graphic design, typography, motion, and digital production standards 
  • Proven ability to concept ideas that work across channels, not just adapt static design to new formats 
  • Experience producing motion and animation work for digital and social, with strong storytelling instincts alongside technical execution 
  • Experience producing integrated work for international or multi-market campaigns, adapting design systems across countries and channels within brand guardrails 
  • Deep understanding of brand identity systems, able to apply, protect, and evolve visual standards across a complex, multi-touchpoint portfolio 
  • Familiarity with regulated industries (financial services, insurance, or similar), or demonstrated ability to work within compliance, legal, and governance frameworks 
  • Experience contributing to brand guidelines, scalable templates, and asset systems that enable consistency and speed across a team 
  • Experience leading and mentoring designers, providing clear creative direction, developmental feedback, and coaching that builds integrated craft capability 
  • Confident presenting and defending integrated creative concepts to senior stakeholders, translating feedback into clear direction for the team 
  • Advanced use of AI tools relevant to integrated design, building effective workflows, evaluating outputs critically, and training others in responsible AI use 
  • Agentic mindset: able to lead a team through complex, multi-format creative challenges, adapting confidently when priorities shift and maintaining quality under pressure
  • Formal degrees are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, study, volunteering, or self-directed learning.

Established in 2004, OLIVER is the world's first and only specialist in designing, building, and running bespoke in-house agencies and marketing ecosystems for brands. We partner with over 300 clients in 40+ countries and counting. Our unique model drives creativity and efficiency, allowing us to deliver tailored solutions that resonate deeply with audiences. 

As a part of The Brandtech Group, we're at the forefront of leveraging cutting-edge AI technology to revolutionise how we create and deliver work. Our AI solutions enhance efficiency, spark creativity, and drive insightful decision-making, empowering our teams to produce innovative and impactful results. 

Role:  Global Head of Analytics

Location:  London, United Kingdom  (2-3 days a week from our London offices)

 

About the role: 

We're looking for a Global Head of Analytics to lead one of the most important practices in our business. This is a senior leadership role with genuine scope; you'll own a global team of around 80 people, spanning audience insight, creative performance analytics, social listening and measurement, search marketing and paid social, all embedded within in-house client teams across Europe, APAC, LATAM and North America. 

Reporting to OLIVER's Chief Strategy Officer, you'll sit at the intersection of creativity, technology and data. You'll help OLIVER and our clients understand not just what's performing, but why, and what to do next. You'll spearhead new solutions in driving creative effectiveness, and proving the value of the creative component of our clients' marketing. 

You'll work closely with Brandtech colleagues in packaging and scaling Group data solutions to drive more value from marketing. 

You'll also play a key role, with your Brandtech colleagues, in shaping how our proprietary Gen AI platform, Pencil, is powered by data and insight; making it smarter, faster and more impactful for the clients who rely on it. 

This is a role for someone who is as comfortable in a client boardroom as they are in a product sprint. Someone who can inspire a globally distributed team, spot commercial opportunity and translate complex data into stories that help businesses make better decisions. 

What you will be doing: 

  • Lead and develop the global analytics practice
    • Provide leadership to a globally distributed team of ~80 analysts and insight specialists, with six direct reports across disciplines and regions
    • Build and sustain a high-performance, collaborative team culture across a diverse, multi-disciplinary group
    • Define and continuously evolve OLIVER's analytics methodologies, tools and frameworks across search, paid social, social listening, audience insight and measurement — ensuring best practice is shared and applied globally
    • Ensure the team has the engineering capability to integrate data sources and build automated solutions at scale
    • Champion data and insight as a strategic differentiator — internally at OLIVER and externally with clients
  • Drive commercial growth
    • Own the analytics revenue line, accountable for delivering 10% year-on-year growth
    • Identify and develop new commercial opportunities: expanding services within existing client relationships and contributing to new business pitches
    • Work with senior client stakeholders to demonstrate and quantify the value of data-led decision-making
    • Act as a senior analytics partner and thought leader for key clients — particularly on creative effectiveness, audience understanding and performance measurement
    • Drive meaningful improvement in client satisfaction, targeting a five-point improvement in client NPS in year one
  • Build and launch new products
    • Partner with data and technology leaders across the Brandtech Group to co-develop proprietary data products and analytics capabilities, with a focus on the creative effectiveness space
    • Package and position Brandtech's data assets in ways that are compelling and value-driving for OLIVER's clients — particularly at the intersection of media, creativity and agentic commerce
    • Lead the scaling of OLIVER's Gen AI-enabled data products, including trend and competitor reporting tools and automated social reporting
    • Scale OLIVER's creative effectiveness measurement approach into a differentiating, client-facing capability
  • Embed Gen AI at the heart of insight
    • Play a central role in ensuring Pencil, Brandtech's proprietary Gen AI platform, is optimally enabled by data and insight
    • Stay at the frontier of Gen AI developments relevant to marketing analytics — bringing new ideas and applications into the business
    • Work with OLIVER's wider leadership team to embed AI-powered insight into client workflows and content ecosystems
  • Shape group-wide data strategy
    • Build strong relationships with Brandtech Group data leaders, contributing to group-wide thinking on data strategy and product development
    • Lead thinking on how media, creativity and data come together — and how LLM recommendation and agentic commerce will reshape content ecosystems

What you need to be great in this role: 

  • Significant senior leadership experience in analytics, data strategy or a related discipline, ideally within a creative or media agency, platform, or technology business
  • A track record of building and scaling high-performing, multi-disciplinary analytics teams in a global or multi-market context
  • Demonstrable success growing revenue and commercialising data or insight propositions
  • Experience developing and launching data products or insight tools, ideally in collaboration with technology partners
  • Deep familiarity with the marketing analytics landscape: performance measurement, audience insight, social listening, search, paid social and creative effectiveness
  • Exceptional strategic thinking — the ability to connect data to business outcomes in ways that resonate with C-suite and board-level stakeholders
  • Strong commercial instincts: experienced in identifying, shaping and closing revenue opportunities
  • Outstanding communication and storytelling skills — able to make complex data feel clear, relevant and actionable
  • Ability to lead and inspire distributed, culturally diverse teams across multiple time zones
  • Experienced in navigating and influencing complex, matrixed organisations
  • Sets the AI strategy for the analytics discipline across OLIVER's global portfolio
  • Genuine fluency in Gen AI and its applications in marketing and data — including hands-on experience building agents and agentic workflows
  • Develops AI capability across teams and client offerings; embeds AI-powered insight into client workflows at scale
  • Leads governance and quality standards for AI-assisted analytics across the practice
  • Contributes thought leadership on AI's role in data, creativity and marketing — internally across Brandtech and externally in the industry
  • Accountability for the analytics revenue line and year-on-year growth targets
  • Experience building and presenting commercial propositions from data and insight capabilities
  • P&L management experience across multiple markets or business lines
  • Track record of presenting financial performance to executive and board-level stakeholders
  •  Formal qualifications are welcome but not required. Equivalent experience counts. Experience can be gained through work, independent research, or professional practice.

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 


What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title. 


What You Will Work On:
 

Technical Leadership 

  • Define and own the technical roadmap for autonomous constellation operations
  • Set the architectural direction for the data platform, reliability systems, and automation infrastructure
  • Stay hands-on: review code, prototype solutions, and get into the details when it matters
  • Establish engineering standards across code quality, system design, testing, and observability, and hold the team to them
  • Be the person engineers come to when the problem is genuinely hard

Team Building & Culture 

  • Recruit, develop, and retain a team of 6 to 10 world-class reliability and platform engineers
  • Set the pace, tone, and ambition for the team and make being on it feel like a privilege
  • Create an environment where engineers grow fast, own their work, and ship things they are proud of
  • Identify gaps and level up engineers through mentorship and not just management

Operational Transformation 

  • Lead the shift from manual, operator-driven processes to fully automated and self-healing operations
  • Define and drive toward SLOs, error budgets, and reliability targets for the constellation
  • Partner with satellite operations and mission teams to translate pain into software solutions

Cross-Functional Influence 

  • Be the technical voice of the team in company-wide conversations about architecture, infrastructure, and platform strategy
  • Influence how Spire thinks about automation, data, and AI/ML across the broader engineering organization

Basic Qualifications: 

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 3 in a technical leadership or staff-level individual contributor role
  • Demonstrated track record building and shipping reliable production systems at scale. You have owned things that could not go down.
  • Deep technical credibility. Engineers on your teams have respected your judgment and not just your title.
  • Experience with SRE principles, reliability engineering, or large-scale automation. You have reduced toil systematically and not just complained about it.
  • Strong foundation in Python, distributed systems, data platforms, and cloud infrastructure
  • Experience hiring and developing engineers. You know what great looks like and how to find it.
  • The communication and influence skills to drive technical decisions across teams you do not directly control

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Experience applying AI/ML or advanced analytics to operational or monitoring problems
  • Experience writing performance software in Rust
  • Background in space systems, aerospace, or highly constrained real-time environments
  • Experience building data lakes, telemetry platforms, or observability infrastructure at scale
  • A history of leading teams through technical transformations and not just maintaining the status quo

title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer - London
description: About Hiya At Hiya, we’re making business calls more trusted, useful, and effective. Voice remains one of the most important ways businesses communicate with their customers, but the value of a call depends on trust. When customers do not recognize who is calling or why, important conversations are missed, customer relationships suffer, and business outcomes are harder to achieve. Hiya helps businesses create trusted calling experiences that benefit both sides of the conversation: enterprises can reach customers with confidence, and customers can answer with confidence. Our products support branded business calling, trusted caller identity, call performance insights, customer engagement, and voice security capabilities that help businesses strengthen relationships and improve outcomes. This role sits in a core business area for Hiya and is focused on helping SMB and enterprise customers succeed. About the Position The DevSecOps Engineer is a leadership and individual contributor role responsible for maturing our security posture across all engineering departments. You will lead the design and implementation of automated, platform-based security solutions, enabling teams to build secure software while maintaining velocity. You will partner closely with Core Tech, Product, and Engineering leadership to define our security roadmap and culture. We’re excited about you because you are a trailblazer who balances high-level strategy with hands-on technical execution. You are comfortable building from near-scratch, thrive on educating others, and possess a "platform" mindset that prioritizes empowering developers over acting as a gatekeeper. What You’ll Do Define and execute a multi-quarter security roadmap for the entire engineering organization. Develop and maintain platform-level security tools that enable automated, self-service security for feature teams. Partner with Core Tech to integrate security primitives into our standard CI/CD and cloud deployment workflows. Conduct cross-team discovery to assess current security posture and identify high-risk technical debt. Mentor junior and peer engineers, fostering a culture where security is integrated into the "you build it, you run it" philosophy. Stay ahead of evolving threat landscapes, specifically regarding supply chain risks and large-scale AI infrastructure. Own and mature our existing detection, SIEM, and incident-response tooling as part of building out the broader security platform — this role inherits live systems, it isn't a blank canvas. Act as a security collaborator to IT on AI-usage risk (data exposure via connectors/agents, prompt injection) — distinct from, and in addition to, securing the AI systems Hiya builds as a product. Qualities that will make you successful: Deep understanding of cloud-native architecture (AWS) and modern security best practices. Proven experience designing "self-service" platforms that developers actually want to use. Strong communication skills—the ability to turn complex security concerns into decisions engineers and stakeholders can act on. High proficiency in at least one modern language and familiarity with agent-based/AI-assisted development tools. You’ll design and implement real-time embedded software, optimize compute-heavy pipelines, and collaborate with hardware and systems teams to bring products from concept to production.
 
This role suits someone who can move comfortably between architecture/design, low-level firmware, and performance tuning—especially where latency, throughput, power, and determinism matter.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware for DSP cores and MCUs (RISC V and/or Arm).
  • Build and optimize real-time signal-processing pipelines (fixed-point and/or floating-point), potentially including FFTs, filters, modulation/demodulation, codecs, feature extraction, or control loops.
  • Develop firmware using a mix of C/C++ (and selective assembly where appropriate), with strong focus on performance, memory, and power optimization.
  • Work with SoC/board peripherals: DMA, timers, SPI, I²C, UART, I²S/TDM, PWM, GPIO, and relevant bus fabrics.
  • Bring up new hardware: boot flows, clocks, memory maps, interrupt vectors, peripheral init, and early validation.
  • Implement and debug drivers and RTOS components (e.g., Zephyr or equivalent), including task scheduling, synchronization primitives, and ISR design.
  • Develop test strategies: unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, test automation, and manufacturing/production diagnostics.
  • Use debugging/profiling tools: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, trace (ETM/ITM), and cycle-accurate profiling when available.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, FPGA/ASIC, systems, and application teams to define requirements and interfaces.
  • Contribute documentation: architecture notes, interface specs, timing budgets, work packages, and bring-up guides.
  • Participate in code reviews and help establish best practices for embedded quality, safety, and maintainability.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong professional experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ for MCUs and/or DSPs.
  • Hands-on experience with RISC V and/or Arm architecture (Cortex M/A), including interrupts, memory, caches, and performance characteristics.
  • Solid understanding of embedded software fundamentals:
  • register-level programming, memory-mapped I/O
  • concurrency (ISRs, RTOS tasks), race conditions, timing determinism
  • fixed-point arithmetic, numerical precision, and overflow/underflow management
  • Proven ability to optimize firmware: cycle counting, memory layout, DMA usage, cache behavior, minimizing latency and jitter.
  • Comfortable with toolchains and build systems:
  • GCC/LLVM-based toolchains, cross-compilation
  • CMake/Make, Meson, linker scripts, map files
  • Strong debugging skills with hardware and firmware:
  • JTAG/SWD debugging
  • root-cause analysis of timing and performance issues
  • Source control expertise (Git) and disciplined engineering practices (code reviews, CI).

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Languages: C, C++, (optional) assembly, Python for test tooling/scripts
  • Architectures: RISC V, Arm Cortex M/A, DSP cores
  • RTOS/OS: Zephyr, embedded Linux (optional)
  • Tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, GDB, OpenOCD/J-Link, logic analyzer, oscilloscope, trace tools
  • Practices: profiling, timing analysis, unit/integration testing, CI/CD for embedded
  • Experience with common DSP libraries/techniques (e.g., CMSIS-DSP, vendor DSP libs) and SIMD/vector optimization patterns.
  • Experience with Zephyr, or embedded Linux on Arm.
  • Familiarity with bootloaders, secure boot, OTA update mechanisms, and field diagnostics.
  • Understanding of digital communications, or audio, processing domains.
  • Exposure to safety/security standards (e.g., MISRA C/C++, IEC 61508, ISO 26262)

title: Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics
description: About Airwallex Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale. Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us. Attributes We Value We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles . You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor. You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next. Who you are We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard. Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale. Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base. What you’ll do Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements. Ensure accurate payment cost configuration: Translate complex scheme rules into fee tables, eligibility criteria and transaction-level logic. Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows. Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution. Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements. Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers. Partner with Product, Finance and Commercial teams to prioritize the highest-value opportunities. Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

Who you are

We are looking for an Associate Director, Payments/Scheme Economics to own the integrity, visibility and management of Airwallex’s payment costs, starting with card scheme fees and interchange fees across Visa and Mastercard.

Reporting to the Head of Strategic Finance, you will be the subject matter expert on scheme economics, translating complex and rapidly changing network rules into accurate system configurations, financial outcomes and business decisions. You will ensure we understand what every payment should cost, that those costs are accurately reflected across our systems and financials, and that we systematically identify opportunities to improve payment economics as we scale.

Over time, the remit will expand across other card schemes, local payment methods and the broader payments cost base.

  • Own scheme economics and rule interpretation: Maintain deep expertise across scheme fees, interchange and network rules. Interpret scheme bulletins, operating regulations and fee schedules, translating changes into clear financial, product and operational requirements.

Partner with Product and Engineering to ensure cost calculation, allocation and customer billing accurately reflect current network rules across markets and payment flows.

  • Protect payment cost integrity: Establish robust governance, testing and controls across scheme configurations. Reconcile expected costs against actual network charges, identify anomalies and leakage, and drive root-cause resolution.

  • Build granular visibility into payment economics: Develop robust models and analytics across markets, products, payment methods and transaction types, creating a clear view of unit economics, margin drivers and cost movements.

  • Drive structural cost and margin optimization: Identify, quantify and execute opportunities to improve economics through transaction qualification, BIN routing, cost configuration, and other levers.   • Shape pricing and commercial decisions: Translate underlying payment economics into recommendations for customer pricing, product design, new market launches and commercial strategy, ensuring growth is supported by sustainable unit economics.

  • Build scalable infrastructure and automation: Partner with Product, Engineering, and Data teams to strengthen cost engines, fee allocation logic, dashboards and automated controls. Apply AI and advanced analytics to accelerate rule interpretation, detect anomalies and surface optimization opportunities.

  • Own complex scheme economics issues: Serve as the escalation point for scheme pricing, interchange and rule-related questions, working directly with Visa, Mastercard and other payment partners where required.

What you’ll bring

  • 7+ years of relevant experience in payments, acquiring, issuing, card networks, payment infrastructure or related roles, ideally within a global PSP, acquirer, scheme, issuer or fintech.

Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics. There are 60 of us today, with decades-long experience building world's best products, optics, and open-source operating systems. We partner and build with globally leading companies like KIA , Supacat , and Galvion , and we were Google Ventures' first investment in Finland. THE ROLE The FOH is already in field trials with military users. Your first project is getting it working with British Army equipment and defence primes, building the integration around what the customer actually needs. As our product line grows you'll take on a widening set of customer integrations across our defence work, each one a different platform, stack and set of interfaces. Your core responsibilities include: Owning customer integrations end to end. Make the FOH work inside a customer's platform: adapt the software, wire it into their sensors, displays, video and connectivity, and get it demo- and trial-ready. Prototype fast in dedicated environments to prove value with a client before it hits the shared codebase. Being Distance in the field. Join demos, trials and exercises with defence clients, support on-site deployments when needed, and bring back what you see and hear on real kit. Bridging the field and the core. Turn what customers need into concrete integration work with the R&D and commercial teams, spot what should become shared product capability, and feed it into the roadmap and, eventually, the shared codebase. You won't be a satellite. You'll join the software standups and reviews and be a real part of R&D. WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU Your work ships and gets used. What you integrate goes into real kit already in trials with military users, and what you learn from demos, trials and exercises with them feeds straight back into the product. You own the whole thread. From first prototype to working integration in the field, it's yours, not passed between five teams. New display tech. Glasses-free computational optics and a see-through HUD, the kind of problem you won't find at most XR jobs. A small team backed to move fast. Around 60 of us, Google Ventures' first investment in Finland, and flat enough that your calls count. OUR EXPECTATIONS What we're looking for: A builder, not a passenger: a hands-on self-starter who takes ownership, works things out when docs are missing, and would rather be with a customer or in the field than at a desk. At least a couple of years of software engineering experience with VR or XR, plus generalist instincts. Comfort across a mixed software stack. You've worked with some of C++, Unity and embedded, and you pick up the rest quickly. Some exposure to electrical integration or software-to-hardware interfaces. We're not expecting deep hardware experience on top of strong software. You're at home in prototype and integration work: incomplete docs, customer-specific stacks, messy interfaces. Good with clients, and happy to be the person representing Distance at a demo or trial. Willing to travel within the UK when needed, and to Finland now and then. It's a bonus, though not required, if you've worked with HMDs, wearable displays or spatial computing, know C++ for integration and application development, can stand up a UI or application stack for quick situational-awareness or demo prototypes, are comfortable with embedded or Linux at integration level, or have seen sensor, display and video interfaces at system level. You'll be based within commuting distance of the Bath office and in the office two to three days a week. Our working language is English. DID WE GET YOU INTERESTED? Apply via the application form. title: Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA)
description: About Norm Ai Norm Ai, the agentic law company, has a client base with a combined $30 trillion in assets under management. Norm Ai pioneered Legal Engineering, the process that empowers lawyers to build and supervise domain-specific AI agents with Norm’s proprietary suite of no-code software tools. Norm Ai technology is deployed inside many of the largest and most consequential institutions in the world. Norm Ai is also the technology behind Norm Law, LLP, a separate but affiliated AI-native law firm built for the era of agentic AI. Norm Law’s attorneys advise leading institutions across private funds, private equity, venture capital, real estate, registered funds, and financial regulation, using the same legal intelligence platform that powers Norm Ai’s products. AI Fluency: Norm Ai expects all team members to be fluent in AI. Successful candidates actively use AI in their day-to-day work to support thinking, creation, and problem-solving. They use it to improve the quality and speed of their work and to continuously refine how work gets done end-to-end. Candidates should be prepared to demonstrate and discuss their AI usage throughout the interview process, including concrete examples of tools, workflows, and outcomes. We look for practical, hands-on experience, not theoretical familiarity. This Role As a Commercial Contracts Associate (NDA), you will work on a high impact team that provides important services to Norm Law’s clients, while using AI agents to streamline the drafting, review, and execution process in providing non-disclosure agreement review for clients. You’ll collaborate closely with partners, clients, and technology teams to deliver efficient, precise, and data-driven legal services for in-house legal teams of leading asset managers. Our practice embraces the use of AI to reduce burden and increase your ability to focus on strategic legal judgment and client engagement. What You'll Do Document Drafting, Review, and Negotiation: Leverage AI agents to generate, compare, negotiate, and redline NDAs tailored to client guidelines Incorporating Legal Context: Advise clients on their NDA playbooks and market standards, including ensuring AI agents understand each client's specific context and comparing client’s actual practices with playbook positions in order to guide updates. NDA Execution: Integrate AI agents into workflow management, execution, negotiation, and coordination with counterparties for any NDAs. Client Advisory: Partner with clients to demonstrate how AI-assisted workflows improve accuracy, transparency, and velocity. Collaboration with Tech: Work closely with the technology teams to continue to make the NDA review process even more efficient using AI. Managing high volumes of requests: Maintain a tracker, manage multiple high priority requests simultaneously and communicate timing expectations to clients and consistently and proactively follow up and move negotiations forward. What We're Looking For Core Qualifications Qualified solicitor admitted in England and Wales, with a current Solicitors Regulation Authority (SRA) practising certificate. 2-3+ years of experience reviewing NDAs or similar agreements. Strong drafting and communication skills; meticulous attention to detail. Interest in applying technology to enhance traditional deal workflows. What Success Looks Like 30 Days: Learn firm AI platforms; begin supporting the commercial contracts team using AI-enabled review and drafting. 60 Days: Independently manage discrete components of NDA review with AI support. 90 Days: Lead AI-augmented workstreams in live NDA reviews, improving efficiency and accuracy in document management and execution processes. Benefits Benefits: pension plan with an employer contribution, medical and dental insurance coverage, employee referral bonus program, initial 2 week onboarding in the US. Work Location Location: Central London Work model: Hybrid In-office expectation: 4-5 days per week Why Join Norm Law You’ll be part of the founding UK team bringing a proven US category leader to a receptive UK market. You’ll have autonomy, visibility, and the opportunity to build meaningful relationships — backed by a world-class product, an experienced executive team, and a growing global reputation. title: Associate Director, Integrated Marketing - Pilotage Stratégique du Marché France
description: Inautalent recrute, pour le compte d'un de ses clients — un acteur international du secteur des applications lifestyle et relationnelles, en croissance active sur le marché français — un(e) Associate Director, Integrated Marketing, en charge du pilotage stratégique du marché France. Le défi : ce poste consiste à identifier soi-même les enjeux et opportunités du marché français, puis à construire et exécuter la stratégie qui en découle — de bout en bout. Le poste est pensé pour quelqu'un qui est à l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, et pour qui la construction d'une stratégie compte autant que sa mise en œuvre concrète sur le terrain. Requirements Le poste, en synthèse : Piloter le marché France de bout en bout : diagnostic des enjeux et opportunités, construction de la stratégie, exécution. Déterminer le marketing mix et faire des recommandations stratégiques sur le mix média payant. Piloter la collaboration quotidienne avec l'agence média, garantir l'alignement stratégique et l'optimisation continue des canaux payants. Construire des plans marketing intégrés multicanaux (média, influence, RP, partenariats), de la rédaction du brief à l'analyse de performance. Communiquer régulièrement les enjeux du marché, la stratégie et les résultats à la direction et aux parties prenantes transverses. Adapter les apprentissages globaux au marché français, et remonter les enseignements locaux à l'organisation globale. Profil recherché : Solide expérience en leadership, avec une capacité démontrée à superviser des responsables de canaux (channel leads) et à porter une stratégie globale cohérente. 8 à 10 ans d'expérience en marketing de marque, marketing intégré ou marketing stratégique, idéalement dans la tech grand public, le lifestyle ou des marques à forte identité culturelle. Expérience en marketing et/ou média avec une expertise approfondie et une réelle compréhension du marché français. Expérience avérée de pilotage autonome d'un marché, du diagnostic des enjeux jusqu'à l'exécution. Expérience avérée du lancement de campagnes multicanales générant à la fois de la connexion émotionnelle et des résultats mesurables. Bonne compréhension du paysage média, des canaux et de la mesure de performance. Solides compétences analytiques, avec une utilisation démontrée de la donnée et des indicateurs pour mesurer l'impact des actions et ajuster la stratégie en conséquence. Expérience dans la gestion de partenariats avec des célébrités, talents, influenceurs ou créateurs de contenu, y compris la gestion de relations avec des agences, est un plus. À l'aise pour opérer sans une large équipe, en portant plusieurs casquettes, de façon autonome. Français natif ou bilingue, anglais courant indispensable. Benefits Conditions : France, full remote — Rémunération : 100 000 € à 111 000 € brut/an — Prise de poste : 1er octobre. Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Une manière instinctive de faire circuler les vêtements, guidée par une attention particulière à ce qui dure. Dans son prolongement, Sézane prend vie en 2013 : la première marque de mode française née en ligne. Puis sont venus enrichir cet univers : Octobre Éditions pour les hommes, Les Composantes, dédiée cette fois à l’art de vivre, et Petit Sézane pour les enfants. Tout s’est construit comme on avance dans la vie : par élans, par gestes spontanés avec cette manière d’apprendre en faisant. Une autre relation au détail, au service et au lien. Une autre manière d’habiller le réel, d’abord en ligne, puis à travers nos Appartements. Nous recherchons aujourd’hui des talents créatifs, structurés et agiles qui partagent l’envie d’améliorer sans cesse tout ce qui peut l’être. Des talents passionnés, autonomes qui conçoivent le travail dans le respect des autres et pour qui rien n'est hors d'atteinte, pour peu qu'on s'en donne les moyens. Envie d’imaginer la suite de cette histoire à nos côtés ? Ecrivez-nous !  Nous recherchons les talents d’un(e) Assistant Chef de Projets Opérations (H/F) pour rejoindre notre équipe à l’occasion d’une alternance d'un an à partir de Janvier 2027. Ce poste est basé à Paris (75). Au sein de la Direction des Projets Opérations, vous accompagnerez la croissance et améliorerez la performance (coûts, qualité, délais, expérience client, RSE) des opérations logistiques à l'échelle globale. Dans le cadre de votre alternance, vous serez amenés à travailler sur des sujets divers tels que l'extension du périmètre RFID sur nos activités logistiques ou encore des projets d'automatisation/robotisation de processus logistiques. Vous aurez pour principales missions : Soutenir le Chef de Projets dans le pilotage des projets transverses, du cadrage à la mise en production jusqu’à la stabilisation post go-live Préparer les instances projets et réaliser un reporting réguliers des projets en termes de coût, délais et qualité. Définir les indicateurs de performances et consolider les gains générés par les projets  Coordonner les différentes parties prenantes internes et externes pour assurer la mise en œuvre des projets logistiques Dans le cadre de processus d'appel d'offres, participer à la rédaction d'un cahier des charges fonctionnel Sur la base de ce cahier des charges, analyser et comparer les offres réceptionnées Assurer une veille concurrentielle et technique pour prendre connaissance de l'état du secteur d'activité et de la concurrence ; Restituer ces analyses et proposer des pistes d'amélioration aux processus existants en fonction des priorités de notre activité logistique et de la roadmap projets.  Requirements Étudiant(e) en école d’ingénieur, de commerce avec une spécialité en logistique, ou équivalent universitaire, vous recherchez une alternance de fin d’étude.  Vous êtes dynamique, volontaire, autonome et rigoureux(se) ; Vous êtes force de proposition et vous appuyez sur d’excellentes capacités d’analyse et de communication ; Vous souhaitez travailler dans un environnement international, et pratiquez pour cela un Anglais courant. title: Analytics Engineer - Finance
description: <div class="content-intro"><h4><strong>Help make the world more hospitable </strong></h4> <p>The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.</p> <p>You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.</p> <p>If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.</p> <h4><strong>About the role</strong></h4> <p>Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:</p></div><p>You'll be the founding analytics engineer in Finance, shaping our data infrastructure and analytical capabilities during a critical transformation. Your expertise in Python, <span data-highlighted="true" data-vc="highlighted-text"><span class="_kqswh2mm"><span class="_5pioz8co _189e1dm9 _1il9buyh _19lc184f _d0altlke" data-testid="definition-highlighter">DBT</span></span></span>, SQL, and Databricks will drive operational efficiency, accelerate our month-end close, and deliver strategic insights that inform capital allocation and IPO readiness. This is a greenfield opportunity to own the analytics roadmap, work directly with Finance leadership, and build infrastructure that powers both scaling and compliance, all at a pivotal moment for Mews</p> <h4>What you would do</h4> <ul> <li>Design and develop analytical features that surface actionable insights for Finance leadership</li> <li>Build, optimise and maintain production-ready ETL/ELT pipelines using DBT, Databricks and SQL</li> <li>Create scalable data models and analytical solutions using modern data modelling techniques</li> <li>Build and champion data quality and testing practices; catch errors before they reach stakeholders</li> <li>Collaborate across Finance to translate business requirements into technical implementations</li> <li>Advocate for modern data practices and continuous improvement of the stack</li> </ul> <h4>What you would bring</h4> <ul> <li>Hands-on production experience building and optimising ETL/ELT pipelines (minimum 3 years)</li> <li>Proficiency in SQL and Python; strong experience with DBT or equivalent modern data transformation tools</li> <li>Experience with Databricks or similar cloud data platforms, or willingness to ramp quickly</li> <li>Strong understanding of data modelling and analytics architecture</li> <li>Comfort working autonomously and managing priorities with ambiguity; ability to break down complex problems</li> <li>Demonstrated commitment to data quality, testing and accuracy; take pride in work that's been thoroughly validated</li> <li><strong>AI Fluency Level 3:</strong> In this role, you'll redesign how Finance approaches data discovery and analysis using AI—not just automating your own work, but building patterns and tools that shape how the whole team questions data and validates insights. You'll use AI to accelerate model development and testing, but critically, you'll actively question what it produces and know when to push back. You've built processes others follow; here, you'll do that with AI as a core enabler.</li> <li><em>For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to&nbsp;<a class="underline underline underline-offset-2 decoration-1 decoration-current/40 hover:decoration-current focus:decoration-current" href="https://mews.atlassian.net/wiki/x/XQOskg">AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates</a> on Confluence.</em></li> </ul> <h4>Nice to have</h4> <ul> <li>Experience with data visualisation tools like Power BI</li> <li>Background working with regulated or governed data</li> <li>Experience scaling analytics in fast-growing startups or scale-ups</li> </ul><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Spain</div><div class="pay-range"><span>€46.000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>€65.000 EUR</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">Czechia</div><div class="pay-range"><span>867 000 Kč</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>1 598 000 Kč CZK</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">UK</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£49,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£55,500 GBP</span></div></div><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">France</div><div class="pay-range"><span>$54,500</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>$65,000 USD</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h4><strong>Pay Transparency at Mews</strong></h4> <p>Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.</p> <p>This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.</p> <p>If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.</p> <h4><strong>What’s in it for you?</strong></h4> <p>Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.</p> <h4><strong>Global benefits</strong></h4> <p>No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:</p> <ul> <li>Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)</li> <li>Participation in our company share program</li> <li>Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)</li> <li>An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development</li> <li>Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself</li> <li>A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year</li> <li>Relocation options, available after one year</li> <li>Flexible, hybrid working options</li> <li>A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance</li> <li>Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Local benefits</strong></h4> <p>You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.</p> <h4><strong>Life at Mews</strong></h4> <p>We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.</p> <p>We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.</p> <p>A few things that define how we work:</p> <ul> <li>High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.</li> <li>Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.</li> <li>We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.</li> <li>AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.</li> </ul> <p>If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.</p> <p>We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.</p> <p>One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.</p> <p>If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.</p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.</em></p> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>A propos de WPP :</strong></p> <p><strong><em>WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance.&nbsp;</em></strong>Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie.&nbsp;<br>Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing.&nbsp;<br>Pour plus d’informations, visitez <a href="http://www.wpp.com/">www.wpp.com</a>.</p> <p>WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients.&nbsp;Pour plus d'informations, visitez <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/">wppmedia.com</a>.</p> <p>Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP :</p> <ul> <li>Être <strong>Extraordinaire</strong> en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.</li> <li>Créer un environnement <strong>Ouvert</strong> en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.</li> <li>Diriger avec <strong>Optimisme</strong> en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Le contexte</strong> :</p> <p>Certifié Ecovadis Or et SBTi (Science Based Targets initiative) pour sa stratégie de réduction carbone, WPP France s'engage depuis plus de 20 ans dans une démarche active de développement durable. Avec plus de 2 000 collaborateurs répartis dans 14 agences en France, le groupe œuvre à intégrer les enjeux environnementaux et sociétaux au cœur de ses activités.</p> <p>En rejoignant nos équipes, vous contribuerez à poursuivre cette dynamique en collaboration avec l'équipe locale, tout en soutenant la direction de la communication dans ses initiatives stratégiques et ses prises de parole institutionnelles. Vous participerez à des projets d'impact positif, en lien avec les valeurs de durabilité et d'innovation qui animent WPP France.</p> <p><strong><br>Vos missions :</strong></p> <p><em>Sustainability</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Participer</strong>&nbsp;à la coordination des projets de WPP sur les sujets d’impact et collaborer avec les équipes déjà investies sur ces thématiques (ressources humaines, juridique, communication interne, conseil client, etc.).</li> <li><strong>Travailler</strong>&nbsp;en direct avec l’équipe internationale et l’équipe France, incluant les référents RSE de chaque agence.</li> <li><strong>Concevoir</strong>&nbsp;et/ou mettre à jour la documentation pour acculturer et sensibiliser les collaborateurs du groupe sur les enjeux RSE, tout en veillant à l’application des meilleures pratiques.</li> <li><strong>Gérer</strong>&nbsp;et coordonner les "Impact Teams" pour renforcer les initiatives internes.</li> <li><strong>Participer</strong>&nbsp;à la proposition d’offres d’accompagnement RSE destinées aux clients.</li> <li><strong>Appuyer</strong>&nbsp;le déploiement des formations internes liées aux enjeux RSE.</li> </ul> <p><em>&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>Communication du groupe / Événements internes</em></p> <ul> <li><strong>Soutenir</strong>&nbsp;la gestion et l’organisation des événements du groupe, incluant la gestion des invitations et la préparation logistique.</li> <li><strong>Épauler</strong>&nbsp;la Directrice Communication de WPP dans la création, l’éditorialisation et la diffusion des communications internes et externes.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compétences requises :</strong></p> <p>Votre Expérience :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Formation :</strong> Étudiant(e) de niveau Bac +4/+5 avec une spécialisation ou des compétences avérées en RSE, une appétence pour la communication sera un réel atout.</li> <li><strong>Expérience précédente :</strong>&nbsp;Une première expérience (stage ou projet académique) en gestion de projet, idéalement avec une dimension environnementale ou sociétale.</li> <li><strong>Secteur :</strong>&nbsp;Un fort intérêt pour le secteur de la publicité, des médias et des nouvelles technologies (incluant l'intelligence artificielle).</li> </ul> <p>Vos Compétences Techniques :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Langues :</strong>&nbsp;Maîtrise de l'anglais indispensable (niveau B2 à C2) pour interagir avec les équipes internationales.</li> <li><strong>Bureautique/Outils :</strong>&nbsp;Maîtrise des outils de gestion de projet et de création de présentations.</li> <li><strong>Expertise métier :</strong>&nbsp;Excellentes capacités rédactionnelles et de communication, associées à un esprit critique et une forte capacité d'analyse.</li> </ul> <p>Vos Qualités Humaines :</p> <ul> <li><strong>Rigueur :</strong>&nbsp;Une haute attention aux détails pour garantir la qualité des livrables et des communications.</li> <li><strong>Organisation :</strong>&nbsp;Excellente gestion du temps et capacité à collaborer efficacement avec des équipes multiples et transverses.</li> <li><strong>Proactivité :</strong>&nbsp;Curiosité, enthousiasme et force de proposition pour faire avancer les sujets environnementaux et sociétaux.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>La vie chez WPP Media et ses avantages</strong></p> <p>Notre engagement à façonner l'avenir des médias se manifeste par un soutien actif au développement professionnel de nos talents, les aidant à atteindre leur plein potentiel. Les réussites et expertises des équipes sont régulièrement mises en lumière lors d'événements fédérateurs qui ponctuent également les moments clés de l'année, renforçant ainsi notre culture d'entreprise collaborative et diversifiée.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Ce que nous offrons&nbsp;:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Une <strong>expérience professionnelle unique</strong> au sein d'une compagnie média renommée, où vous pourrez acquérir des compétences précieuses et développer votre réseau professionnel.</li> <li>L'opportunité de travailler avec des <strong>clients de premier plan</strong> et de contribuer à la création de campagnes publicitaires de grande envergure.</li> <li>Un <strong>accompagnement personnalisé</strong> pour tous les Padawans (stagiaires/alternants chez WPP Media) de votre intégration à votre départ … ou pas&nbsp;!</li> <li><strong>Des déjeuners, cafés, afterworks</strong> ainsi que différents évènements qui rythmeront votre année chez nous.</li> <li>Un <strong>campus</strong> à Levallois-Perret qui rassemble toutes les agences WPP (WPP Media et ses sœurs) au terminus de la ligne 3&nbsp;!</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Process de recrutement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Entretien avec l’équipe recrutement : Un premier pré-entretien téléphonique de 5mn, puis un entretien de 30mn en visio-conférence par un membre de notre équipe recrutement. Cela nous permettra de mieux connaître vos compétences et votre expérience, et vous donnera l'occasion de poser des questions sur le poste et l'entreprise.</li> <li>Entretien opérationnel : Pour évaluer l'adéquation de vos compétences et de votre profil par rapport aux exigences du poste.</li> <li>Étude de cas : Une étude de cas vous sera proposée afin d’évaluer vos compétences techniques liées au poste. Une restitution vous sera proposée.</li> </ul> <p>Nous nous engageons à rendre ce process aussi rapide et efficace que possible, et à maintenir une communication ouverte et transparente tout au long du process.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>WPP Media garantit l'égalité des chances et considère tous les candidats sans discrimination ni considération de caractéristiques particulières. Nous nous engageons à cultiver un environnement de respect où chacun se sent à sa place et bénéficie des mêmes opportunités d'évolution professionnelle.</p> <p>Consultez notre politique de confidentialité pour tout savoir sur la protection de vos données <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy">politique de confidentialité</a>.</p> <p>Bien que nous étudiions toutes les candidatures reçues, nous ne contactons que les personnes sélectionnées pour un entretien.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto"><span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">Please read our <a href="https://www.wppmedia.com/pages/privacy-policy#:~:text=WPP%20Media%20Privacy%20Notice%20for%20Recruitment">Privacy Notice</a></span></span><span class="TextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8" lang="EN-CA" data-contrast="auto">&nbsp;<span class="NormalTextRun SCXW227196529 BCX8">for more information on how we process the information you provide.</span></span><span class="EOP SCXW227196529 BCX8" data-ccp-props="{&quot;201341983&quot;:0,&quot;335559739&quot;:0,&quot;335559740&quot;:276}">&nbsp;</span></p></div> Find Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

raw.description:
El Puesto

Serás responsable de impulsar el crecimiento comercial de nuestras soluciones ERP, software de gestión, movilidad, planificación, RR. HH. e Inteligencia Artificial en clientes nuevos y existentes. Trabajarás en un entorno B2B tecnológico, con ciclos de venta consultivos y clientes de tamaño medio y grande, colaborando estrechamente con los equipos de producto, consultoría, marketing y dirección.

Inteligencia Artificial: una parte importante de tu trabajo
En Freematica estamos incorporando la IA como una nueva capa de valor sobre nuestras soluciones y también como herramienta para transformar nuestra propia forma de trabajar.

Por ello, buscamos una persona que tenga interés real por la Inteligencia Artificial y sea capaz de incorporarla a su actividad comercial.

Utilizarás herramientas de IA para:

  • Mejorar la prospección y segmentación de cuentas
  • Preparar reuniones y analizar información de clientes
  • Identificar necesidades y oportunidades de negocio
  • Personalizar mensajes y propuestas comerciales
  • Analizar conversaciones, oportunidades y pipeline
  • Automatizar tareas comerciales y administrativas
  • Generar contenidos y argumentarios comerciales
  • Obtener insights a partir de datos y actividad comercial
  • Explorar nuevos casos de uso de IA aplicables a nuestros clientes y sectores
No buscamos necesariamente un perfil técnico de IA. Buscamos una persona con curiosidad, criterio y capacidad para entender cómo aplicar la tecnología y la IA para conseguir mejores resultados comerciales y aportar más valor al cliente.


Responsabilidades

  • Dominar rápidamente nuestro producto: comprender en profundidad nuestras soluciones, módulos, arquitectura básica y principales casos de uso para poder mantener conversaciones de valor tanto con perfiles de negocio como técnicos
  • Venta consultiva B2B: analizar los procesos, necesidades y retos del cliente, entender su modelo operativo y proponer la solución tecnológica que mejor responda a sus objetivos
  • Prospección y generación de negocio: identificar empresas objetivo, detectar oportunidades, realizar contactos iniciales, cualificar leads y desarrollar nuevas cuentas
  • Discovery y análisis de necesidades: preparar y dirigir reuniones de descubrimiento, identificar pain points, interlocutores, procesos, necesidades y criterios de decisión
  • Presentaciones y demos comerciales: presentar nuestras soluciones de forma orientada al negocio, adaptando el discurso a cada sector y perfil interlocutor
  • Diseño y seguimiento del proceso comercial: trabajar con un proceso estructurado y un pipeline definido: prospección → cualificación → discovery → demo → propuesta → negociación → cierre
  • Gestión rigurosa del CRM: mantener Salesforce actualizado, registrar actividad, próximos pasos, probabilidad de cierre, interlocutores y cualquier información relevante de las oportunidades
  • Forecast comercial: realizar previsiones de ventas rigurosas, identificar riesgos y mantener actualizado el estado real de cada oportunidad
  • Elaboración de propuestas a medida: coordinarte con los equipos de producto, consultoría y tecnología para transformar las necesidades detectadas en propuestas claras, viables y competitivas
  • Gestión de cuentas y crecimiento: detectar oportunidades de ampliación, nuevas soluciones, servicios y funcionalidades dentro de nuestra base instalada


Requisitos

  • Experiencia previa de 4-6 años o más en venta consultiva B2B de tecnología, preferiblemente en ERP, software de gestión empresarial, SaaS, Cloud, IT o soluciones digitales
  • Alta capacidad de aprendizaje técnico: comodidad trabajando con productos complejos y capacidad para traducir funcionalidades tecnológicas a beneficios de negocio
  • Experiencia en procesos de venta consultiva y ciclos comerciales B2B
  • Mentalidad de proceso y orientación a métricas
  • Experiencia trabajando con CRM (preferiblemente Salesforce), pipeline, forecast y metodologías comerciales estructuradas
  • Rigor en el seguimiento de oportunidades y reporting
  • Orientación a resultados y al cierre, manteniendo una visión de relación a largo plazo con el cliente
  • Capacidad para mantener conversaciones con diferentes interlocutores: dirección, operaciones, RR. HH., administración, IT, etc.
  • Autonomía y proactividad:
    • Capacidad para organizar tu agenda y priorizar cuentas
    • Iniciativa para generar oportunidades y abrir nuevas puertas
    • Capacidad para tomar decisiones y avanzar sin supervisión constante
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicación, presentación y negociación
  • Interés y conocimientos prácticos en Inteligencia Artificial y herramientas de productividad basadas en IA
  • Residencia en España y disponibilidad para desplazamientos puntuales a clientes y oficinas
Se valorará muy positivamente
  • Formación en áreas tecnológicas, empresariales o similares: Ingeniería, ADE, Economía, Informática, etc.
  • Experiencia previa en software empresarial, ERP o SaaS B2B
  • Experiencia en proyectos de transformación digital o implantación de soluciones de gestión
  • Conocimiento de los sectores de Limpieza, Facility, Seguridad, Servicios, Outsourcing o Instalaciones, o sectores con modelos operativos similares
  • Experiencia utilizando herramientas de IA generativa como ChatGPT, Copilot, Claude u otras herramientas similares aplicadas al trabajo diario
  • Conocimientos sobre automatización de procesos, agentes de IA, análisis de datos o aplicación de IA a procesos empresariales
  • Experiencia trabajando con equipos de Marketing y Product
  • Conocimiento de metodologías de venta consultiva y frameworks comerciales
  • Experiencia con Salesforce u otros CRM
  • Nivel de inglés suficiente para trabajar con documentación técnica y tecnológica


Tus ventajas

  • Incorporarte a una compañía sólida, con más de 28 años desarrollando software propio de gestión empresarial y una base estable de clientes en toda España
  • Trabajar con un producto tecnológico real, complejo y con un amplio recorrido de evolución
  • Participar en un momento especialmente interesante de transformación de nuestro producto, con el desarrollo de nuevas soluciones basadas en movilidad, automatización e Inteligencia Artificial
  • Formar parte de un equipo técnico y especializado donde tu opinión puede influir tanto en el producto como en la estrategia comercial
  • Oportunidad real de crecimiento profesional en el área comercial y de desarrollo de negocio
  • Entorno donde se valoran la iniciativa, la autonomía, el rigor y la capacidad de aportar
  • Acompañamiento inicial para que puedas conocer nuestro producto, nuestros sectores y nuestra metodología comercial
  • Condiciones competitivas acordes a la experiencia aportada, con fijo + variable por objetivos


Esperamos recibir su solicitud.

Más que un perfil que simplemente "venda software", buscamos a una persona que quiera convertirse en referente comercial de nuestras soluciones. Alguien capaz de sentarse con un cliente, entender cómo funciona su negocio, detectar dónde están sus problemas, explicar cómo puede ayudar la tecnología y construir una propuesta que tenga sentido tanto operativa como económicamente.Y, especialmente, alguien que entienda que la IA no es solo una tecnología más, sino una nueva forma de trabajar, vender y aportar valor a nuestros clientes.Si te motiva vender soluciones tecnológicas complejas, disfrutas entendiendo el negocio del cliente, tienes curiosidad por la tecnología y la IA y te gusta construir relaciones comerciales basadas en confianza, conocimiento y resultados, nos encantará conocerte.Envíanos tu CV y cuéntanos brevemente qué proyectos de venta consultiva tecnológica has liderado, qué tipo de soluciones has vendido y cómo estás utilizando actualmente la IA en tu trabajo.

Headquartered in Paris, we are now present in 23 countries across all continents, with a team of 1,700 employees.</p> <p>Our mission is to help businesses unlock the full potential of AI and data by developing tailor-made solutions that address their specific industry challenges. As pioneers in this field, we combine technological expertise with operational excellence, working alongside the world's leading market players. Our clients span all key economic sectors - industry, retail, luxury, consumer goods, healthcare, and finance - and include major international corporations.</p> <h3><strong>The Data Analytics Team</strong></h3> <p>You will join our Data Analytics Chapter, a team of 60 professionals with expertise across dashboarding, analytics engineering, marketing measurement, and low-code data science. We are one of three technical teams at Artefact (alongside Software Engineering and Data Science), forming a tech community of 160 people. Despite working on different client engagements, we maintain a strong culture of knowledge sharing through dedicated communities of practice. We are growing fast, with the ambition to double our team size over the next five years.</p> <h3><strong>What you will be doing - Key responsibilities</strong></h3> <p>As a Senior Data Analyst, you will transform our clients' businesses through effective data collection, processing, and visualization, acting as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders.</p> <h4><strong>Delivering end-to-end analytics projects</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Frame use cases with business teams, validate data availability, and define the right approach.</li> <li>Design and implement dashboards, data products, and pipelines that drive business decision-making.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Driving technical excellence</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Translate business requirements into scalable analytics architectures and pipelines.</li> <li>Apply modern analytics engineering practices and promote best practices in data modeling and testing.</li> <li>Leveraging the latest GenAI developments in order to deliver the maximum value possible for our clients</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Being a trusted advisor</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Extract valuable insights and communicate them in clear, actionable terms.</li> <li>Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and act as a go-to expert for analytics guidance.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Contributing to team development</strong></h4> <ul> <li>Mentor junior data analysts and share best practices through workshops and documentation.</li> <li>Contribute to internal accelerators and maintain active technology watch.</li> </ul> <h4><strong>Qualifications - What we are looking for</strong></h4> <p>We are looking for profiles with deep expertise in one of the following domains, combined with openness to work across others. Our flexible career track allows you to specialize or develop a broader skill set.</p> <h3><strong>Core requirements</strong></h3> <ul> <li>3+ years of hands-on experience in a data-driven environment.</li> <li>Strong expertise in at least one of the following domains: <ul> <li><strong>Dashboarding &amp; Data Visualization: </strong>Power BI, Looker, Tableau, or Superset.</li> <li><strong>Analytics Engineering: </strong>dbt, with experience on BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks.</li> <li><strong>Marketing Analytics &amp; Measurement: </strong>CDP platforms (Treasure Data, Hightouch, Tealium), MMM, attribution, clean rooms.</li> <li><strong>Low-Code / No-Code Data Science: </strong>Dataiku, Copilot Studio, or similar platforms.</li> </ul> </li> <li>Solid foundation in SQL and Python.</li> <li>Familiarity with Git and software engineering fundamentals (versioning, testing, code quality).</li> <li>Experience working in cloud environments (GCP, Azure, or AWS).</li> </ul> <h4>&nbsp;</h4> <h4><strong>Nice to have</strong></h4> <p>Experience with generative AI applied to analytics (MCP for BI, conversational data interfaces), exposure to multiple domains above, knowledge of statistics and machine learning fundamentals.</p> <p>Beyond technical expertise, we value: intellectual curiosity, pragmatism and creativity, ability to bridge business and technical teams, autonomy and reliability, and clear communication to build client trust.</p> <h3><strong>Our recruitment process</strong></h3> <ol> <li>HR call&nbsp;</li> <li>Technical Interview&nbsp;</li> <li>Business Interview</li> <li>Fit Interview</li> </ol> <p><em>At Artefact, we recruit our employees only on the basis of our needs and the individual qualities of each candidate. We ensure the development of their professional skills and responsibilities without discrimination of any kind, including belief, gender, age, disability, ethnic origin, sexual orientation, membership of a political organization, religion, trade union or minority group.</em></p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

  • Verify digital control and configuration of analog/mixed-signal circuitry across normal operation, corner cases, and error conditions.
