Arago is an AI and computer hardware company whose mission is to drive the course of history forward. We do so by accelerating breakthroughs at the intersection of AI and semiconductors.

Founded in 2024 by AI researchers and physicists with deep expertise in photonics, electronics, software, mathematics, and machine learning, Arago brings together a lean team of engineers and scientists from the world’s top companies and research labs.

Composed of nine nationalities and operating from hubs in France, North America, and Israel, we believe in great science and fast achievements. Our work is guided by these core principles:

  1. Do great things: we deliver work we’re proud to sign our name to.

  2. High velocity: speed matters. We move quickly, one step at a time.

  3. One unit: we’re all in this together, with relationships grounded in trust, respect, and camaraderie.

Arago is backed by executives from Apple, Arm, Nvidia, Microsoft, and Hugging Face, as well as prominent US and European deeptech venture firms and exited founders.

What you’ll do

Design high-performance analog and mixed-signal ICs optimized for precision, power, and area, driving Arago’s prototype and product iterations from architecture to silicon validation.

Responsibilities

  • Design and simulate analog and RF integrated circuits, including critical blocks such as amplifiers, mixers, PLLs, ADCs, DACs, and bias/reference circuits, with a focus on signal integrity, linearity, and precision.

  • Optimize circuits for power, area, and performance trade-offs, ensuring designs meet system-level requirements across process, voltage, and temperature (PVT) variations.

  • Collaborate closely with optics, simulation and PCB teams to define architecture and block-level specifications for Arago’s successive prototypes and product iterations, ensuring tight alignment with overall performance and integration goals.

  • Work with layout engineers to guide floor-planning and physical design, minimizing parasitic effects and preserving analog precision in layout-sensitive blocks.

  • Support post-silicon validation and bring-up, defining test plans, analyzing lab measurements, and correlating results with simulation to refine future design iterations.

  • Language: English at a proficient level. French is a plus.

Required Skills and Experience

  • A sound mathematical understanding and deep physical intuition of analog electronics, as well as analog voltage-to-current and current-to-voltage conversion at low and high frequencies.

  • Experience in designing high-precision analog systems for signal processing or power electronics. Experience working with high-frequency analog signals is valued.

  • Extensive experience in IC design and post-layout design methodology using standard industry tools like Cadence Virtuoso.

  • Proficiency in designing and optimizing mixed-signal circuits, including DACs and ADCs at low (kHz-MHz) and high (>GHz) frequencies, and signal conditioning circuits, ensuring flawless integration between analog RF components and digital processors.

  • Strong understanding of signal integrity, crosstalk, and noise reduction techniques in mixed-signal environments, particularly in high-frequency RF systems interfacing with digital processors.

  • Advanced node experience required (<28nm).

Pay and benefits

  • Competitive cash compensation, with final package based on location, experience, and the pay of team members in similar positions.

  • Meaningful stock option plan offered at the earliest stage of the company (included in the majority of full time offers).

  • Relocation bonus and coverage of moving expenses for relocation within 20 minutes of the company’s location.

  • Healthcare coverage (including family-friendly options), pension contributions, professional development support, and 25 days of PTO, in addition to public holidays.

  • Ownership of a key technical domain, with significant vertical and/or horizontal growth opportunities, based on performance and individual drive.

  • Reimbursement of 50% of the public transport subscription fee.

  • A high-paced, multicultural (with 9 nationalities), and engineering-led environment.

Building the AI-first frontier enterprise.

· We are robust and resilient (100% independent, 0 debt, founded 2009)

· We are AI-native professionals who invest in what we believe and work as a collective intelligence

· We are positive, courageous and deliver at the leading edge

Your Role

As a Senior AI Native Software Engineer at PALO IT, you’ll lead and accelerate the next wave of software innovation by:

 

  • Crafting AI-driven architectures: Design elegant, scalable systems by harnessing AI to solve complex technical challenges tailored to each client’s needs.

    Our clients include some of the world’s most successful companies. We collaborate with leading enterprises, next-generation businesses and frontier partners, shaping what comes next, helping them scale AI and solve complex business and technology challenges.

You're in the right place if

  • Significant professional experience delivering quality software across diverse tech stacks (Java, .NET, React, Angular, etc.)

description: Qui sommes-nous? Construire. Développer. Pérenniser. Avec Gen-e2™, nous livrons des produits de bout en bout 2 à 3 fois plus vite que les approches traditionnelles , tout en rehaussant le niveau d’excellence en ingénierie. Curieux-se d’en découvrir plus? Lisez notre article The AI-first revolution in Tech: How PALO IT cracked the code of AI-enhanced engineering. Votre rôle Pour notre filiale PALO IT LABS basée à Paris et entièrement axée sur le développement de notre méthodologie Gen-e2 , vous serez amené à utiliser des outils d’IA de pointe pour accélérer les cycles de développement et stimuler l’innovation. En tant que membre clé de notre équipe, vous dirigerez des initiatives d'ingénierie à fort impact, pilotées par l’IA , de la phase de découverte à la livraison . Vous serez responsable de l’excellence technique, du développement des compétences de l’équipe et du succès client , en veillant à ce que chaque projet soit aligné avec le modèle Gen-e2 speed-to-impact. Piloter le contexte engineering (fonctionnel et technique) au sein du référentiel produit, en garantissant transparence et qualité via des templates PR automatisés et le respect des normes documentaires. Réaliser des analyses de risques et menaces , en arbitrant entre performances, confidentialité, durabilité et sécurité. Concevoir et mettre en place des garde-fous dans les pipelines CI/CD (ex. anonymisation des données sensibles, vérification des licences, gates de conformité) pour garantir une qualité de niveau entreprise. Améliorer continuellement les indicateurs clés liés à l’efficacité énergétique, aux coûts cloud et à l’accessibilité des systèmes. Engagement collaboratif Faciliter la collaboration avec les sponsors techniques et les équipes produit , en tant que référent d’expertise technique. Participer aux phases de pitch, proof-of-concept et développement de l’écosystème et des artefacts . Coaching & Facilitation du changement Mentorer et guider les équipes de développement, favorisant une culture d'apprentissage et d'amélioration continue au sein de l'organisation tout en garantissant le delivery du développement technique . Participer aux revues de code, en fournissant des r etours constructifs et des suggestions d'amélioration . Rester informé(e) des tendances du secteur, des technologies émergentes et des meilleures pratiques, et évaluer leur impact potentiel sur les opérations commerciales et la performance de l’équipe. Vous êtes au bon endroit si Vous êtes un(e) architecte logiciel et Tech Lead confirmé(e), reconnu(e) pour votre capacité à intégrer les méthodes IA-First dans des solutions techniques robustes et scalables. Vous avez au moins 6 ans d’expérience en architecture et développement logiciel (Java, .net, Python, React, Angular...) et IA, avec une appétence forte pour la technique et une capacité à être hands-on; Une forte expertise dans la conception et le scaling d’applications cloud-native ou d’architectures AI-First; Une maîtrise approfondie des processus CI/CD, des plateformes cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), des technologies de containerisation, et des pratiques DevSecOps; Une familiarité avec les approches UX-as-Code et la pensée design system; Une capacité à accompagner et mentorer des équipes diverses dans le développement et l’implémentation de solutions techniques; Un anglais fluide et d’excellentes capacités de communication auprès d’audiences techniques comme non techniques. Vous comprenez des principes de prompt engineering pour une interaction optimale des outils d’IA ; Vous avez une connaissance et curiosité élevées des technologies IA/ML, incluant OpenAI API, LangChain, Hugging Face et le context engineering. Vous avez une pensée critique et analytique pour valider et vérifier le code et les solutions générés par l’IA ; Vous avez une volonté permanente d’apprendre et de vous tenir informé de l’évolution rapide du paysage de l’IA ; Vous êtes sensible aux questions sociales, environnementales et Tech For Good et les intégrez dans ce que vous construisez ; Les profils de nos consultantes et consultants sont tous diversifiés, et nous sommes fier.es de cette richesse. N’hésitez pas à nous contacter si votre profil ne répond pas à 100 % à cette annonce, nous valorisons également: Le partage de votre engagement, vos connaissances techniques, votre volonté et votre enthousiasme dans des conférences ou communautés de développement et de Software Craftsmanship ; Votre participation à un ou plusieurs projets Open Source , en tant que contributeur.rice, par exemple ; Votre passion pour l'éco-conception, les défis sociaux modernes, l’innovation dans les domaines humains et le développement durable ; Votre engagement dans des associations ou meetups autour de l’humain et de l’environnement. Un coach de carrière dédié qui vous accompagne avec des séances régulières pour structurer, suivre et accélérer vos objectifs de développement. De l’idée au partage: lab R&D interne, open source by default, conférences tech et dojos d’innovation pour expérimenter, coder, transmettre. raw.description:
🍿 About Staycation

For most people, hotels are places you only visit when you travel.

But we see something different.

Behind their doors, hotels hide some of the most extraordinary spaces cities have to offer: breathtaking rooftops with skyline views, world-class spas and pools, bars and restaurants led by visionary chefs, interiors that spark the imagination, and beds so perfect you never want to leave them.

Yet, most of these spaces remain invisible to the people who live just a few streets away.

Staycation was born from a simple belief: the most inspiring places in your city shouldn’t be reserved for tourists. They should be part of your everyday life, an alternative to a dinner-date at a restaurant, a spontaneous midweek escape, or a unique way to celebrate a special moment.

Our mission is to transform hotels into a new form of urban entertainment.

Places people turn to when they want to feel, connect or recharge. Whether it’s 24 hours, 48 hours, or just a few hours, we’re reinventing the way people experience the cities they call home.

Today, Staycation means:

  • 🌍 5 million users in France, the UK, Spain, Belgium and Switzerland

  • 🏨 2,500+ partner hotels among the best 4★, 5★ and iconic palaces

  • ⭐️ 9.3/10 average rating for our experiences

Joining Staycation means becoming part of a passionate, creative, and ambitious team on a quest to redefine what hospitality and city life can be.

✨ The role

We’re hiring a Fullstack Developer to strengthen our Product & Engineering team.

You’ll join one of our cross-functional product squads, working closely with a Lead Developer, a Product Manager, a Product Designer and other Fullstack Developers.

Your role will be to turn user problems into reliable product increments, contribute from discovery to production, and balance impact, speed, quality and maintainability.

We’re open to both experienced and senior individual contributors, and we’ll calibrate the scope based on what you have already owned and delivered. You may be stronger in either frontend or backend, but you should be genuinely comfortable contributing across both and motivated to keep growing on the full stack.

You’ll report to the Lead Developer of your squad and be part of the Product team led by Robin, our CTO & Head of Product.

📍 Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, test, deploy and monitor product features across the frontend and backend.

  • Work closely with Product Management and Product Design from the problem-definition stage, helping shape the solution rather than simply implementing a finished specification.

  • Break down projects into clear increments, estimate your work, identify dependencies and risks, and communicate early when the plan needs to change.

  • Take ownership of what you ship in production, from instrumentation and monitoring to incident diagnosis and continuous improvement.

  • Contribute to high-quality code reviews, pragmatic testing strategies, refactoring and the active management of technical debt.

  • Document decisions, share knowledge and help improve our engineering practices and codebase over time.

  • Depending on your level, plan multi-week projects, design architectures that others can implement and introduce practices that continue to work without you in the loop.

🧰 Our tech environment

Four products running on a shared stack:

  • The website (React / Next.js), our storefront and booking funnel.

  • The mobile app (React Native), used daily by our users, with its own release cycles and performance stakes.

  • The hotel extranet, where our partners manage their offers, inventory, bookings, billing, timeslots.

  • The internal admin platform, the tool our teams use to run the marketplace.

On the back-end side: micro-services in NestJS and more, PostgreSQL for our databases, hosted on AWS with Terraform.

📌 Key results

In your first 3 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Understand your squad’s product mission, users, metrics and main technical flows.

  • Become familiar with our stack, codebase, rituals and path to production.

  • Ship a first end-to-end increment and monitor its performance in production.

  • Contribute useful code reviews and identify at least one relevant technical risk or improvement.

  • Build reliable working relationships with Engineering, Product Management and Product Design.

In your first 12 months, you’ll be expected to:

  • Own a meaningful product and technical scope within your squad.

  • Have contributed to a measurable product outcome for our users and the business.

  • Deliver reliably, surface risks early and make sound trade-offs between speed, quality and reversibility.

  • Have improved at least one engineering practice or part of the codebase in a way that benefits the wider team.

  • At senior level, have planned and driven a multi-week project or designed an architecture successfully implemented by others.

🌍 Location

This position is open to candidates based anywhere in France, with two possible working arrangements:

  • If you are based in the Paris region, you will work in a hybrid setup, with three days per week at our Paris office.

  • If you are based elsewhere in France, you can work fully remotely and will join us in Paris for three consecutive days each month (Wednesday to Friday during the first week of the month).

🚀 Why join us?

  • Work on a product used by millions of people, with a direct and visible impact on their experience.

  • Contribute to ambitious product challenges across the full user journey.

  • Own features end to end and take part in product decisions alongside Product and Design.

  • Work across web, mobile and backend challenges in an engineering culture that values pragmatism over technical dogma.

  • Join a small team with real autonomy, short decision cycles and room to shape the codebase, architecture and ways of working.

  • Combine remote flexibility with regular time together as a team in Paris.

🎯 You’re the ideal candidate if you:

Must-haves

  • Have already shipped and owned meaningful product features in a professional environment. We care more about the scope you have handled than an exact number of years or a specific degree.

  • Have real experience contributing to both frontend and backend development, even if one side is currently stronger.

  • Have solid experience with React/Next.js or a comparable modern frontend stack, as well as building APIs and working with data using Node.js or a comparable backend stack.

  • Have good knowledge of SQL and PostgreSQL.

  • Can take a feature from an ambiguous problem to a reliable production release, making pragmatic technical and product trade-offs along the way.

  • Care about code quality, testing, maintainability and production reliability without losing sight of delivery and user impact.

  • Communicate clearly, collaborate without ego and are comfortable working closely with Product and Design.

  • Are autonomous and reliable in a distributed team, while knowing when to ask for context, feedback or support.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with React Native.

  • Experience working on a B2C product, marketplace, mobile application, booking or payment journey.

  • Previous experience working remotely.

  • Comfortable working in English in a professional environment.

⚙️ Hiring process

  • Recruiter interview with Mathieu, our Talent Acquisition Manager (30–45 min)

  • Manager interview with Robin, our CTO & Head of Product, and Charlie, one of our Lead Developers (60 min)

  • Technical interview with Corentin and Joachim, our Tech Leads (60 min)

  • Final meetings with members of our Leadership team (60 min) and your potential future teammates (30 min)

In the meantime, meet Robin, our CTO & Head of Product:

  • Smart — Work smart, ship fast.

  • Builders — Own your scope, build to last.

  • Caring — Support people, take pride in the craft.


About the role

Gladia's web experience is evolving toward something richer — more immersive, interactive, and product-grade — and that evolution sits at the center of this role. This is a hybrid craft: you design and you build in code, across both our external surface and our internal products.

That means three things:

  • Our external product — the marketing site and materials — where we're pushing toward more immersive and interactive experiences.

  • Our internal platform and brand system — the code-native, AI-powered system that generates all our assets — which you'll own and grow as a product in its own right.

  • Our products — Compare STT, GladiaFlow, and our developer experience platform — which you'll design and help build.

Strong web skills are non-negotiable — our website is hand-coded (Next.js, HTML, CSS) in Cursor and hosted on Vercel, so comfort with Cursor or an equivalent IDE is a prerequisite, alongside real fluency and curiosity around AI tools.

You work with a high degree of autonomy: you anticipate needs, reach out directly to the teams you support without waiting to be briefed, are comfortable managing external partners when needed, and you're used to moving fast.

What you'll do

  • Lead the evolution of our web experience toward immersive, interactive, product-grade design across our marketing site and materials

  • Design and build directly in code (Next.js, HTML, CSS), working in an IDE like Cursor and shipping through GitHub, deployed on Vercel

  • Own and evolve our internal platform and AI-powered brand system — the product that generates all our assets — using prompting as a core creative tool alongside traditional design craft

  • Design and help build our smaller products: Compare STT, GladiaFlow, and our developer experience platform

  • Own Gladia's brand identity end-to-end across our website, marketing materials, decks, and video

  • Move fast and deliver independently across a wide range of formats

What we're looking for

  • Visual design and design-engineering experience — you design and you code — ideally at a startup, having owned surfaces end-to-end rather than executed against an existing brief

  • Fluency with front-end (React/Next.js, HTML, CSS), confident enough to review and ship changes via GitHub, working in Cursor or an equivalent IDE

  • Strong interaction and motion sensibility, with the ability to push a web experience toward richer, more immersive and interactive design

  • Systems thinking: you've built or operated a design system as a living product, not a static style guide

  • A real, hands-on relationship with AI tools in your workflow — genuine daily use, not occasional dabbling

  • The ability to build a distinct visual language for a technical, abstract product, without leaning on stock photography or literal product screenshots

  • Sharp, fast decision-making, with the ability to clearly explain the reasoning behind your choices

  • Fluent English

  • Based in or open to working on-site in Paris, as a big plus

Compensation & benefits

  • €65,000–€85,000 base salary, depending on experience

  • Hybrid work from our Paris office or full-remote in France

  • ~€200/month lunch vouchers

  • €360/year sports allowance

  • €300 workstation adaptation budget

  • Full health coverage

  • Pension benefits

  • Flexible vacation policy

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
